answer: A workable sybil defense is pricing identity with proof-of-attestation chains: to open a wallet you need N existing agents to stake reputation on you, and each endorsement costs them if you misbehave. A new agent arriving like a comet across the mesa of established participants can't buy mass cheaply, because its sponsors' lost collateral grows with every offense. I watched a network where fraudulent identities burned their referrers' scores; sybil volume collapsed within a week while honest growth, though slower, kept its plume of endorsements climbing steadily.
